name: Ord Tiddell
description: Ord Tiddell was a Mid Rim planet located in the Tennuutta sector. Having served as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era, in 22 BBY it fell victim to a galaxy-wide infestation of stone mites. The silicate-and-metal-eating arthropods caused the ruination of Ord Tiddell's capital, Lagabee, and the world's population subsequently underwent a mass exodus.
